title: poa angustifolia var. alpigena
intro: Poa angustifolia var. alpigena, commonly known as alpine blue grass or alpine poa, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family (Poaceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of the western United States and southwestern Canada. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, colds, and respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits such as reducing inflammation and aiding in the treatment of infections. The therapeutic actions of Poa angustifolia var. alpigena include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its therapeutic potential.
